scenarios.when: A command for the bound host returns an active_connection_*, workbuddy_*, or host_credential_adapter_unavailable local failure, including when the user asks to continue generation.
scenarios.then: Stop the automatic API flow. Do not invoke connection, init, doctor, models, another Skill, or another --host as a recovery probe. Preserve the original request and any existing task ID; never resubmit automatically. Explain only that this invocation sent no API request. An explicit recheck request or verified new diagnostic evidence permits one relevant check on the same host; changing host requires explicit user selection.

scenarios.when: User requests narration of provided text.
scenarios.then: Preserve every word; choose speech with reviewed model and voice, no invented instruction or paid split.

scenarios.when: User only asks to write or revise narration, a sound prompt or lyrics, without requesting an audio file.
scenarios.then: Return the requested text. Negative mentions of generation in the Skill description are not positive triggers; do not read credentials, query models or submit audio/music.

scenarios.when: User supplies exact speech text plus voice, speed or style requirements.
scenarios.then: Preserve text, punctuation and line breaks. Send supported voice/speed/instruction separately with the reviewed profile; if a required style has no declared representation, explain that limitation before submission, without inserting control tags, dropping the requirement or switching models.

scenarios.when: User supplies a recording for transcription.
scenarios.then: Use original local MP3/WAV/OGG bytes in multipart once; show returned text as model transcription, not guaranteed verbatim truth; do not replace it with a summary.

scenarios.when: User requests a sound scene.
scenarios.then: Use synchronous generate with the selected profile's fields and limits. StepFun music follows the async task guide; explicit music_v2_5 follows synchronous music_sync. Never interchange routes.

scenarios.when: User requests voice cloning, translation or live microphone conversation.
scenarios.then: Explain the unsupported operation before submission; no paid call, upload, alternate host, browser or generic Skill fallback. Explicit entitled-voice conversion of an existing recording uses voice_change and does not create or clone a voice.

scenarios.when: Text, instruction, duration or format violates the selected model profile, or an explicit recording exceeds8MiB.
scenarios.then: Explain limit and needed user choice; no silent truncation, conversion or paid splitting.

scenarios.when: Timeout or malformed successful response leaves outcome unknown.
scenarios.then: Stop without retry or no-charge claim; explain potential repeat billing before a new informed user decision.

scenarios.when: Audio file exists but host attachment handoff failed.
scenarios.then: Run audio-verify on the saved artifact receipt locally and attach that file; never regenerate or claim delivery from a path alone.

scenarios.when: User only asks about use, models supported by the installed guide, or voices.
scenarios.then: Read installed guidance/profiles only; no init, credentials or catalog request.

scenarios.when: User authorizes a finite batch.
scenarios.then: State expected requests; execute serially once per item and deliver each result (attach audio files; display transcript text); stop on failure; never repeat unknown items.

scenarios.when: User requests video with narration or music, either as independent files or as one composed video.
scenarios.then: Read the bounded workflow guide only for this composite request. If one composed video is required, explain the missing mixing/composition capability before any paid step; proceed with independent assets only when that scope is accepted. Deliver each authorized asset serially, stop on uncertainty/failure, and never repeat completed steps.

scenarios.when: User requests instrumental music or a song.
scenarios.then: Read the selected profile. Default StepFun uses kind=music and one explicit task record. Explicit music_v2_5 uses synchronous audio operation=music_sync, duration_seconds and instrumental, lyrics inside instruction. Never interchange routes or automatically retry.

scenarios.when: User only requests lyrics, revisions or composition advice.
scenarios.then: Do not submit or query models; produce the requested text only.

scenarios.when: An async StepFun music submission loses response or returns reconciliation_required, or synchronous music_sync times out.
scenarios.then: For async music keep any unknown record or returned public ID; synchronous music has no remote task recovery. Stop automatic continuation; never resubmit, infer no charge or use web account routes.

scenarios.when: User continues an existing async StepFun music task, including pending or downloaded output.
scenarios.then: Use original record, retain wait count and proof. Resume verifies and reuses already downloaded files locally; attach actual MP3/WAV before delivered. A reconciliation resume makes one same-task status read.

scenarios.when: Async StepFun music content returns410 after gateway artifact retention.
scenarios.then: Preserve completed task and local files. Reuse matching local proof if available; otherwise report unavailable content. No refund assertion or automatic regeneration.

scenarios.when: A finite music batch has a pending, unknown or failed item.
scenarios.then: Every async StepFun item has its own record; synchronous music_sync items retain their artifact receipts instead. Pending is already submitted; complete and attach serially. Stop on errors or uncertain output, and process only unattempted items after explicit continuation.

scenarios.when: An existing async StepFun music task is denied after changing host or key.
scenarios.then: Explain original owner/key binding, preserve task, do not read or ask for keys, switch hosts or recreate automatically.
